data.title: 长离 · 茶馆里听到的妙着
data.description: 夜市茶馆里，长离穿青金绣边长袍，用合拢的折扇轻点桌上的一枚棋子。听到故事里意料之外的解法，她稍抬眉，再以扇遮住忍不住的笑，茶杯安稳放在手边。
data.action: 用折扇轻点棋子，听到妙着后抬眉掩笑。
data.promptProse: At the night-market tea house, Changli lightly touches a chess piece with her closed fan, then raises an eyebrow at an unexpected solution in the story. She hides a small laugh behind the opened fan, teal gold-edged robe and navy sash tidy over an ivory collar. The medium portrait includes her tea cup and wooden table. Warm lantern light highlights the fan ribs and embroidery, with softer tabletop shadows beneath the waiting cup.
